An '''Imperial soldier''' serving in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] was responsible for escorting the [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]]'s [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']]. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] failed to prevent Madine's rescue by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commandos]], but was tasked by Lennox, who had in turn been given the assignment by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to remove the [[Jedi Diplomat]] [[Rachi Sitra]] from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and prevent Rebel sympathisers from interfering with Vader's affairs in the [[City/Legends|city]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial soldier is the player character in the Dark Side scenario campaign of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''{{'s}} [[2010]] set, ''[[The Price of Victory]]''.
